# Third-party notices

This file lists the third-party packages that the application contains or needs when it runs, with the licence of each. It was generated on 2026-11-03 by `scripts/public/notices.mjs` from the lockfile and the installed Python packages, and CI checks it for a licence outside the allow list (MIT, ISC, BSD, Apache-2.0, 0BSD, Python-2.0, PSF, MPL-2.0 for files only, CC-BY-4.0 for data and OFL-1.1 for fonts and W3C-20150513 for the owlrl package).

## Source code of packages under the Eclipse Public Licence

The packages below are shipped unmodified with their licence text. The Eclipse Public Licence 2.0 requires that the source code can be obtained, and it is available at the address given for each package.

- elkjs 0.9.3: https://github.com/kieler/elkjs

## Tools that are bundled or used to build

The installers contain Electron, which is licensed under MIT, and the Chromium and Node.js code inside it, which carry their own licences. Electron ships them in the files LICENSE and LICENSES.chromium.html in the application folder.

The compiler executable is built with PyInstaller, which is licensed under GPL-2.0-or-later with an exception that allows a program built with it to be distributed under any licence. PyInstaller is a build tool and no part of it other than its bootloader is included in the executable.

## Brain model and fonts

The brain model and the fonts have their own notices in the file `NOTICE`.
